sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

As you progress through the levels, the colors become increasingly fast-paced, and the game demands quick reflexes and sharp focus. But that's what makes it so addictive - the sense of accomplishment you feel when you get it right is matched only by the frustration you experience when you get it wrong.

The game's core mechanic is based on a simple yet elegant principle: the player must tap the correct color as it appears on screen. But what makes it so challenging is the speed at which the colors appear and disappear. One moment, the color is there - the next, it's gone. And in that split second, you have to make a decision - tap the correct color or watch as your chances of success slip away.

The game's controls are intuitive and responsive, allowing players to tap the correct color with ease.
